name: @agent-control-stack/dc-relay
description: Self-hosted Desktop Commander relay / control plane (extracted from the Desktop Commander fork, ADR 0019).

scripts.start: bash -c 'set -a; source "$HOME/.config/dc-relay/relay.env"; set +a; exec node dist/server.js'
scripts.test: node test/test-control-plane.js && node test/test-control-plane-pairing-crypto.js && node test/test-control-plane-pairing.js && node test/test-control-plane-mcp.js && node test/test-control-plane-consent.js && node test/test-control-plane-prefix.js && node test/test-control-plane-server-contract.js && node test/test-control-plane-supabase-store.js
